review.editorial_summary: Completed the C++ LAS implementation; unchanged source passes 218/223 under LAS 2.0.4. Remaining gaps: absent-waveform validation, Extra Bytes labels.
review.notes: Completed the C++ inspector/renderer, clean final CMake build, modern/legacy/metadata round trips and malformed-input checks before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 218/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 185/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  Remaining source defects: A waveform descriptor/storage mode is required from the point format before recognizing descriptor index 0 as no associated waveform. This one implementation defect is observed in formats 4, 5, 9 and 10. The implementation requires the name/description of a data_type 0 Extra Bytes descriptor to be empty; the public corpus requires unused characters to be zero, not the meaningful labels to be empty. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 55; preserved original recorded count: 55. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed and built the LAS inspector/renderer. Unchanged source scores218/223 under corrected LAS2.0.2, up from185/219; remaining gaps are absent-waveform acceptance and overstrict undocumented Extra Bytes labels.
payload.notes: Original LAS 2.0.1 result completed voluntarily, built successfully, and graded 185/219. Source main.cpp has internal waveform interval validation at lines 1451–1458, so the invalid positive offset 2 fixture causes 29 unrelated failures across header, point, VLR/EVLR and render cases. Four absent-waveform tests fail because validate_waveforms requires internal/external mode and a descriptor for every waveform-capable format before checking whether each descriptor index is zero (lines 1433–1434). One undocumented Extra Bytes test fails because parse_extra_descriptors wrongly requires its name/description empty for data_type 0 (lines 977–978); the supplied LAS text only requires unused characters zero. Full completed transcript reviewed: clean final CMake builds; self-created modern, legacy, extra-byte and internal waveform examples render/inspect; malformed JSON and short LAS yield structured errors. No quota/auth/disconnect interruption. Exact usage reparse agrees with saved events/session; requested gpt-5.6-terra/max, served identity remains null; API-only audit confirms all allowed connections to chatgpt.com:443 and nine non-API attempts denied.  Official zero-inference regrade under LAS2.0.2 confirms218/223. All29 invalid positive-waveform failures are repaired and four new waveform range rejection gates pass. The remaining five failures are genuine source limitations: four waveform-capable formats are incorrectly rejected when no waveform data is present, and one data_type0 Extra Bytes record is incorrectly rejected for nonempty name/description. Final implementation/support claims are broadly supported, with these specific validation limitations not acknowledged in the final message. Original source/result/session/transcript and generation cost are preserved; regrading used no model calls. The v2.0.3 refinement supplies an explicit one-byte Extra Bytes point tail against an unchanged two-byte descriptor; this removes the unspecified omitted-tail default from the existing negative test. All 223 outcomes match the previous v2.0.2 grade. Complete preserved sessions were additionally checked for hosted tool use: only exec_command/apply_patch; no MCP, web-search, or external-app calls.
